compatibilityIssues: Migration from Web Forms to .NET 8 required
upgradeSteps: Refactor Web Forms to Razor Pages/MVC

issues.impact: All database access code must be rewritten. Entity configurations using EntityTypeConfiguration<T> must be migrated to IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>. DbModelBuilder patterns must be changed to ModelBuilder patterns.
issues.description: The application uses Entity Framework 6.2.0 which is NOT compatible with .NET 8. Entity Framework 6.x is a .NET Framework-only library and must be completely replaced with Entity Framework Core 8.0.0.
issues.recommendation: Migrate to Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore 8.0.0, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer 8.0.0, and Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design 8.0.0. Update all DbContext implementations, entity configurations, and LINQ queries to be compatible with EF Core.
issues.title: Entity Framework 6.2.0 Not Compatible with .NET 8

issues.impact: All logging statements must be updated. LogManager.GetLogger() calls must be replaced with ILogger<T> dependency injection. log4Net.xml configuration must be migrated to appsettings.json or Serilog configuration.
issues.description: The application uses log4net 2.0.10 which is a legacy logging framework. While technically compatible, it's not recommended for .NET 8 applications and should be replaced with Microsoft.Extensions.Logging or Serilog.
issues.recommendation: Replace with Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions 8.0.0 and Serilog.AspNetCore 8.0.0. Update all ILog references to ILogger<T> and configure structured logging in Program.cs.
issues.title: log4net 2.0.10 Legacy Logging Not Recommended for .NET 8

issues.impact: All System.Web dependencies must be refactored. HttpContext.Current must be replaced with IHttpContextAccessor. Server controls must be replaced with Razor syntax.
issues.description: The project references System.Web (line 173 in .csproj) which is NOT available in .NET 8. This is a .NET Framework-only assembly.
issues.recommendation: Remove System.Web reference. Replace with ASP.NET Core equivalents: IHttpContextAccessor for HttpContext access, IWebHostEnvironment for server paths, Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http for HTTP utilities.
issues.title: System.Web Reference Not Available in .NET 8

issues.impact: All HttpContext.Current references must be refactored. Session state access patterns must be updated to use ASP.NET Core session middleware.
issues.description: The application uses HttpContext.Current pattern which is not available in ASP.NET Core/.NET 8. Found 4 usages across the codebase.
issues.recommendation: Replace HttpContext.Current with IHttpContextAccessor injection. Use dependency injection to access HttpContext in services. For middleware, access HttpContext directly from the context parameter.
issues.title: HttpContext.Current Usage

issues.impact: All page lifecycle logic must be restructured. Event-driven postback model must be replaced with HTTP verb-based handlers. ViewState dependencies must be eliminated.
issues.description: The application uses Page_Load events in 10 different pages. Page lifecycle events are specific to Web Forms and must be migrated to Razor Pages OnGet/OnPost handlers.
issues.recommendation: Convert Page_Load to OnGet/OnGetAsync methods in Razor Page models. Migrate postback handlers to OnPost/OnPostAsync methods. Use model binding instead of manual control value extraction.
issues.title: Web Forms Page Lifecycle Events

issues.impact: All .aspx pages must be rewritten as .cshtml Razor Pages. Server control syntax must be replaced with Razor syntax. Data binding expressions <%#:Item.Property%> must be converted to @Model.Property.
issues.description: The application extensively uses ASP.NET Web Forms server controls (ListView, HyperLink, ContentPlaceHolder, ScriptManager, etc.) which do not exist in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Replace server controls with Razor syntax and HTML helpers. ListView → @foreach loops with HTML tables. HyperLink → <a asp-page> tag helpers. ScriptManager → standard script tags with CDN references.
issues.title: ASP.NET Web Forms Server Controls

issues.impact: All master page hierarchies must be restructured. ContentPlaceHolder sections must be redesigned. Master page code-behind must be moved to appropriate locations.
issues.description: The application uses Master Pages (Site.Master, Site.Mobile.Master) which are replaced by Layout pages in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Convert Master Pages to _Layout.cshtml. Move ContentPlaceHolder sections to @RenderBody() and @RenderSection(). Migrate master page code-behind logic to ViewComponents or custom base page models.
issues.title: Master Pages Not Supported

issues.impact: All configuration access via ConfigurationManager must be replaced with IConfiguration. Connection strings must be migrated. System.web and system.webServer sections must be handled in Program.cs middleware configuration.
issues.description: The application uses Web.config for configuration which is replaced by appsettings.json in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Create appsettings.json and appsettings.Development.json. Migrate connection strings, app settings, and configuration sections. Use IConfiguration and Options pattern for accessing settings.
issues.title: Web.config Not Used in .NET 8

issues.impact: All application lifecycle events must be rewritten. HTTP modules must become middleware. Application state must be replaced with singleton services.
issues.description: The application uses Global.asax for application startup and lifecycle events which is replaced by Program.cs and middleware in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Migrate Application_Start logic to Program.cs. Convert Application_BeginRequest to middleware. Move Session_Start logic to session configuration. Replace Autofac.Integration.Web with ASP.NET Core DI.
issues.title: Global.asax Application Events

issues.impact: All DI configuration must be rewritten. Property injection modules must be removed. Service registration must be moved to Program.cs.
issues.description: The application uses Autofac.Integration.Web which is specific to Web Forms and not compatible with ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Use ASP.NET Core's built-in DI container or migrate Autofac to Autofac.Extensions.DependencyInjection for ASP.NET Core. Register services in Program.cs using builder.Services. Remove IContainerProviderAccessor interface.
issues.title: Autofac Web Forms Integration

issues.impact: All DbContext implementations must be rewritten. Entity configurations must use IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>. Database initializers must be replaced with migrations.
issues.description: The DbContext inherits from System.Data.Entity.DbContext which must be changed to Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.DbContext.
issues.recommendation: Inherit from Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.DbContext. Replace connection string constructor with DbContextOptions<T>. Use dependency injection for DbContext. Update OnModelCreating to use ModelBuilder instead of DbModelBuilder.
issues.title: Entity Framework 6 DbContext Implementation

issues.impact: All entity configurations must be rewritten. Fluent API syntax differences must be addressed. Navigation property configurations may need updates.
issues.description: Entity configurations use EF6's EntityTypeConfiguration which is replaced by IEntityTypeConfiguration in EF Core.
issues.recommendation: Create separate configuration classes implementing IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>. Update configuration syntax for EF Core (e.g., HasRequired becomes HasOne). Move configurations to separate files in Infrastructure/Data/Configurations.
issues.title: Entity Framework 6 Configuration API

issues.impact: DI container integration must be updated. ContainerDisposalModule and PropertyInjectionModule must be removed from Web.config.
issues.description: Autofac.Web 4.0.0 is designed for ASP.NET Web Forms and is not compatible with ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Replace with Autofac.Extensions.DependencyInjection for ASP.NET Core integration, or use the built-in ASP.NET Core DI container.
issues.title: Autofac.Web Package Not Compatible

issues.codeSnippet:
<package id="Microsoft.AspNet.FriendlyUrls" version="1.0.2" targetFramework="net472" />
<package id="Microsoft.AspNet.ScriptManager.MSAjax" version="5.0.0" targetFramework="net472" />
<package id="Microsoft.AspNet.ScriptManager.WebForms" version="5.0.0" targetFramework="net472" />
issues.impact: Routing configuration must be rewritten. Script bundling must be replaced. AJAX functionality must use modern JavaScript frameworks.
issues.description: Multiple Microsoft.AspNet.* packages are Web Forms-specific and not compatible with .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Remove all Microsoft.AspNet.* packages specific to Web Forms. FriendlyUrls → ASP.NET Core routing. ScriptManager → standard script tags. Web.Optimization → Use built-in bundling or external tools like Webpack.
issues.title: Microsoft.AspNet Web Forms Packages

issues.impact: Session access patterns must be updated. Session configuration must be added to Program.cs. Session serialization may need attention for complex objects.
issues.description: The application uses classic ASP.NET session state which requires configuration in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Configure ASP.NET Core session middleware in Program.cs. Use ISession interface instead of direct dictionary access. Consider using distributed cache for web farm scenarios. Evaluate if session state is actually needed or can be replaced with stateless alternatives.
issues.title: Session State Usage

issues.codeSnippet:
<httpModules>
  <add name="ContainerDisposal" type="Autofac.Integration.Web.ContainerDisposalModule, Autofac.Integration.Web" />
  <add name="PropertyInjection" type="Autofac.Integration.Web.Forms.PropertyInjectionModule, Autofac.Integration.Web" />
  <add name="TelemetryCorrelationHttpModule" type="Microsoft.AspNet.TelemetryCorrelation.TelemetryCorrelationHttpModule, Microsoft.AspNet.TelemetryCorrelation" />
  <add name="ApplicationInsightsWebTracking" type="Microsoft.ApplicationInsights.Web.ApplicationInsightsHttpModule, Microsoft.AI.Web" />
issues.impact: All HTTP pipeline processing must be rewritten as middleware. Module order becomes middleware order in Program.cs.
issues.description: The application configures HTTP modules in Web.config which must be replaced with middleware in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Convert HTTP modules to ASP.NET Core middleware. Remove Autofac modules (handled by DI). Replace telemetry modules with Application Insights SDK for ASP.NET Core. Implement custom middleware for any custom modules.
issues.title: HTTP Modules Configuration

issues.impact: All service methods must become async. Page handlers must use async/await. Database operations must use async equivalents.
issues.description: The CatalogService uses synchronous database operations which should be async in modern .NET applications.
issues.recommendation: Convert all database operations to async. Change method signatures to return Task<T>. Use ToListAsync(), FirstOrDefaultAsync(), etc. Update all callers to await async methods. Add CancellationToken parameters.
issues.title: Synchronous Database Operations

issues.impact: Database initialization strategy must be completely rewritten. CatalogDBInitializer class must be refactored to use migrations and seeding.
issues.description: The application uses EF6 Database.SetInitializer which doesn't exist in EF Core.
issues.recommendation: Replace with EF Core migrations. Use Database.Migrate() in Program.cs to ensure database is created and up to date. Move seed data logic to a separate seeding method called after migration.
issues.title: Database Initializer Pattern

issues.impact: All route definitions must be rewritten. URL generation must use ASP.NET Core helpers. Friendly URLs pattern must be reimplemented.
issues.description: The application uses Web Forms routing (RouteConfig.RegisterRoutes) which must be replaced with ASP.NET Core routing.
issues.recommendation: Replace with ASP.NET Core endpoint routing. Use MapRazorPages() in Program.cs. Update route definitions to use Razor Pages conventions or attribute routing. Remove GetRouteUrl() calls and replace with tag helpers.
issues.title: Web Forms Routing Configuration

issues.impact: Bundle configuration must be removed. Scripts.Render() and Styles.Render() calls must be replaced with standard link/script tags.
issues.description: The application uses System.Web.Optimization for script and CSS bundling which is not available in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Use ASP.NET Core built-in bundling and minification, or use external tools like Webpack, Vite, or npm scripts. Consider using CDN references for popular libraries. Implement asp-append-version for cache busting.
issues.title: System.Web.Optimization Bundling

issues.impact: All logger initialization must be removed. Logging calls must be updated to structured logging. Log configuration must be migrated from log4Net.xml to appsettings.json.
issues.description: The application uses static ILog fields with LogManager.GetLogger() which should be replaced with injected ILogger<T>.
issues.recommendation: Replace with constructor-injected ILogger<T> from Microsoft.Extensions.Logging. Update all _log.Info(), _log.Error() calls to structured logging patterns. Configure logging providers in Program.cs.
issues.title: log4net Static Logger Pattern

issues.impact: Project file must be completely rewritten. All dependencies must be listed as PackageReference. Build process may need adjustments.
issues.description: The project uses old-style .csproj format which should be converted to SDK-style format for .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Convert to SDK-style project: <Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web">. Set TargetFramework to net8.0. Use PackageReference instead of packages.config. Remove unnecessary properties and imports.
issues.title: Old-Style Project File Format

issues.impact: All incompatible APIs must be replaced. Package versions must be updated. Runtime behavior changes must be addressed.
issues.description: The project targets .NET Framework 4.7.2 which must be changed to net8.0.
issues.recommendation: Change to <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework> in SDK-style project. Ensure all dependencies are .NET 8 compatible. Test for any API changes or behavioral differences.
issues.title: Target Framework .NET Framework 4.7.2

issues.impact: User control must be rewritten. All references in master pages must be updated to use view component tag helpers.
issues.description: The application includes a ViewSwitcher user control (.ascx) which must be converted to a View Component or Partial View.
issues.recommendation: Convert to a Razor View Component or Partial View. Move code-behind logic to the component's Invoke/InvokeAsync method. Update rendering to use Razor syntax instead of server controls.
issues.title: ViewSwitcher User Control

issues.impact: Telemetry configuration must be updated. HTTP modules must be removed. Telemetry initialization must be rewritten.
issues.description: The application uses Application Insights packages for Web Forms which need to be replaced with ASP.NET Core versions.
issues.recommendation: Replace with Microsoft.ApplicationInsights.AspNetCore 8.x. Remove ApplicationInsights.config. Configure Application Insights in Program.cs using builder.Services.AddApplicationInsightsTelemetry().
issues.title: Application Insights Web Forms Integration

issues.impact: All .aspx markup must be rewritten as Razor Pages. Data binding syntax completely changes.
issues.description: The application uses Web Forms data binding expressions (<%#:Item.Property%>) which must be converted to Razor syntax.
issues.recommendation: Convert to Razor syntax: @item.Name in @foreach loops. Replace ListView with @foreach. Update all <%#: %> expressions to @ expressions.
issues.title: Data Binding Expressions

issues.impact: All pages must use constructor injection. Property injection configuration must be removed.
issues.description: The application uses Autofac property injection for services in pages (e.g., public ICatalogService CatalogService { get; set; }).
issues.recommendation: Replace with constructor injection in Razor Page models. Services will be injected through the PageModel constructor. Remove property injection module from configuration.
issues.title: Page Property Injection

issues.impact: All configuration access must use IConfiguration. App settings must be in appsettings.json.
issues.description: The application uses ConfigurationManager.AppSettings which should be replaced with IConfiguration.
issues.recommendation: Inject IConfiguration and use configuration.GetValue<bool>("UseMockData"). Migrate appSettings from Web.config to appsettings.json. Use strongly-typed configuration with IOptions<T> pattern.
issues.title: ConfigurationManager Usage

issues.impact: Navigation property loading strategy may need optimization. Query performance may differ.
issues.description: EF6 Include syntax may need adjustments for EF Core, particularly for multiple includes.
issues.recommendation: Verify Include syntax works in EF Core. Consider using ThenInclude for nested properties. Add AsNoTracking() for read-only queries to improve performance.
issues.title: Include Navigation Property Loading

issues.impact: Update behavior should be reviewed. Concurrency handling may need attention.
issues.description: The code uses db.Entry(catalogItem).State = EntityState.Modified which works in EF Core but may have different behavior.
issues.recommendation: Consider using db.Update(catalogItem) instead for clearer intent. Make methods async with SaveChangesAsync(). Add proper change tracking and concurrency handling.
issues.title: Entry State Modification

issues.impact: Package management approach changes. Some packages may need version updates.
issues.description: The project uses packages.config for NuGet packages which should be migrated to PackageReference format.
issues.recommendation: Convert to PackageReference in SDK-style .csproj. This is done automatically when converting project format. Verify all packages are compatible with .NET 8.
issues.title: packages.config Format

issues.impact: All redirect calls must be updated. Page handlers must return IActionResult.
issues.description: The code uses Response.Redirect which should be replaced with RedirectToPage in Razor Pages.
issues.recommendation: Replace with return RedirectToPage("/Index") in Razor Pages. Use proper routing names instead of URL strings. Consider using PRG (Post-Redirect-Get) pattern.
issues.title: Response.Redirect Usage

issues.impact: Validation patterns should be reviewed and potentially enhanced.
issues.description: The code uses this.ModelState.IsValid which will continue to work but validation approach may need updates.
issues.recommendation: Ensure model validation is properly configured with data annotations. Use ModelState.IsValid in OnPost methods. Consider adding FluentValidation for complex validation scenarios.
issues.title: ModelState Validation

issues.codeSnippet: PaginationNext.NavigateUrl = GetRouteUrl("ProductsByPageRoute", new { index = Model.ActualPage + 1, size = Model.ItemsPerPage });
issues.impact: All URL generation must be updated. Route names must be converted to page paths.
issues.description: The application uses GetRouteUrl() for generating URLs which must be replaced with Razor Pages URL helpers.
issues.recommendation: Replace with Url.Page() in code or asp-page tag helper in markup. Define page routes using @page directive. Update route parameter syntax.
issues.title: GetRouteUrl Pattern

issues.impact: Custom handlers must be rewritten as middleware or endpoints.
issues.description: If the application has any custom HTTP handlers, they must be converted to middleware or endpoints.
issues.recommendation: Review for any IHttpHandler implementations. Convert to middleware using app.Use() or map to endpoints using app.Map(). Consider using minimal APIs for simple handlers.
issues.title: IHttpHandler Pattern

issues.impact: Static file paths may need updating. Folder structure requires reorganization.
issues.description: Static files in Web Forms are served automatically. ASP.NET Core requires explicit configuration.
issues.recommendation: Add app.UseStaticFiles() in Program.cs. Ensure wwwroot folder structure is correct. Move Content, Scripts, Images folders to wwwroot. Update all references to use /css/, /js/, /images/ paths.
issues.title: Static File Serving Configuration

issues.impact: Mobile-specific templates removed. Responsive design should be implemented.
issues.description: The application has a separate mobile master page (Site.Mobile.Master) which should be replaced with responsive design.
issues.recommendation: Remove separate mobile master page. Implement responsive design using CSS media queries and Bootstrap. Use single layout with responsive breakpoints.
issues.title: Mobile Master Page

issues.impact: Class naming will follow standard conventions.
issues.description: The page class uses underscore prefix (_Default) which is unconventional for public classes.
issues.recommendation: Rename to proper naming convention (DefaultPageModel or IndexModel) when converting to Razor Pages. Follow ASP.NET Core Razor Pages naming conventions.
issues.title: Underscore Prefix in Class Names

issues.impact: Project structure will be reorganized into proper layers.
issues.description: The application has Models, Services, and ViewModels mixed in the Web project. Should follow clean architecture.
issues.recommendation: Separate into clean architecture layers: Domain (entities), Application (services, DTOs), Infrastructure (data access), Web (pages, view models). Create separate projects for each layer.
issues.title: Models in Wrong Location

issues.codeSnippet:
CatalogBrandId = int.Parse(Brand.SelectedValue),
CatalogTypeId = int.Parse(Type.SelectedValue),
Price = decimal.Parse(Price.Text),
issues.impact: Input validation will be more robust. Exception handling improved.
issues.description: The code uses int.Parse() and decimal.Parse() without try-catch which could throw exceptions.
issues.recommendation: Use model binding with data annotations instead of manual parsing. Implement proper validation attributes. Use TryParse for safer parsing or rely on model binding validation.
issues.title: Input Validation on Parse Operations

issues.impact: Error handling will be more robust and consistent.
issues.description: Service methods lack try-catch blocks and error handling.
issues.recommendation: Add comprehensive error handling. Use try-catch blocks for database operations. Log errors using ILogger. Return Result<T> pattern or throw custom exceptions. Add global exception handling middleware.
issues.title: Missing Error Handling in Services

issues.impact: Resource management handled by DI container.
issues.description: The service implements IDisposable and manually disposes DbContext which is handled by DI in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Remove manual Dispose implementation. Let ASP.NET Core DI container handle DbContext lifetime. Register DbContext with appropriate scope (typically scoped).
issues.title: Manual Dispose Pattern

issues.codeSnippet:
public const int DefaultPageIndex = 0;
public const int DefaultPageSize = 10;
issues.impact: Configuration becomes more flexible and centralized.
issues.description: Default page size and index are defined as constants in the page which should be in configuration.
issues.recommendation: Move to appsettings.json configuration. Create strongly-typed PaginationOptions class. Use IOptions<PaginationOptions> pattern.
issues.title: Magic Numbers for Pagination

issues.impact: ID generation may be simplified if HiLo not required.
issues.description: The application uses a custom HiLo generator for IDs which may not be necessary with EF Core.
issues.recommendation: Review if HiLo pattern is still needed. EF Core supports HiLo natively with UseHiLo(). Consider using identity columns or GUID for simplicity if HiLo not required.
issues.title: HiLo ID Generation Pattern

issues.impact: Correlation tracking will use modern patterns.
issues.description: The application uses custom ActivityId helper with Trace.CorrelationManager which has better alternatives in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Use built-in Activity.Current for distributed tracing. Leverage System.Diagnostics.Activity for correlation. Integrate with Application Insights or OpenTelemetry.
issues.title: ActivityId Correlation Pattern

issues.impact: Testing infrastructure needs to be created from scratch.
issues.description: No unit test projects were found in the solution. Modern applications should include comprehensive tests.
issues.recommendation: Create test projects: [ProjectName].UnitTests and [ProjectName].IntegrationTests. Use xUnit, FluentAssertions, and Moq. Test services, repositories, and page handlers. Aim for 80%+ code coverage.
issues.title: No Unit Tests Found

issues.impact: Project will have proper documentation for future maintenance.
issues.description: No README.md or documentation files found in the project.
issues.recommendation: Create README.md with project overview, setup instructions, and migration notes. Add architecture documentation. Document API endpoints and data models.
issues.title: Missing Documentation

recommendations: Begin migration by addressing critical blockers: (1) Migrate Entity Framework 6 to EF Core 8, (2) Remove all System.Web dependencies, (3) Convert project to SDK-style .csproj targeting net8.0, (4) Replace Web.config with appsettings.json, (5) Migrate Global.asax to Program.cs

Implement clean architecture with separate projects for Domain, Application, Infrastructure, and Web layers. Move entities to Domain, services to Application, data access to Infrastructure, and UI to Web (Razor Pages).

Convert all 7 .aspx pages to Razor Pages (.cshtml). Replace Master Pages with _Layout.cshtml. Convert server controls to Razor syntax. Replace Page_Load with OnGet/OnPost handlers. Eliminate ViewState dependencies.

Migrate all data access to EF Core patterns: Convert DbContext, update entity configurations to IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>, implement repository pattern, make all operations async, add proper error handling and logging.
Replace Autofac Web Forms integration with ASP.NET Core DI. Move service registration to Program.cs. Replace property injection with constructor injection. Remove IContainerProviderAccessor pattern.
Replace log4net with Microsoft.Extensions.Logging or Serilog. Update all logging calls to structured logging. Configure logging in Program.cs. Remove log4Net.xml configuration.

Migrate all configuration from Web.config to appsettings.json. Replace ConfigurationManager with IConfiguration. Implement Options pattern for strongly-typed configuration. Handle environment-specific settings.

Create comprehensive test projects for unit and integration tests. Test all service layer logic, repository implementations, and page handlers. Aim for 80%+ code coverage. Use xUnit, FluentAssertions, and Moq.

Evaluate if session state is truly needed. If required, configure ASP.NET Core session middleware. Consider distributed cache for web farm scenarios. Replace with stateless alternatives where possible.
Reorganize static files into wwwroot structure. Configure static file middleware. Replace System.Web.Optimization bundling with modern approach (CDN, Webpack, or ASP.NET Core bundling).
Create comprehensive documentation including README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, MIGRATION_NOTES.md, and API documentation. Document all breaking changes and migration steps taken.
